title: Anime’s Next Big Live-Action Adaptation Has Landed on Netflix
content: When it comes to live-action anime adaptations, Netflix appears to be the biggest streaming service that is wading into this recently successful territory. One Piece, Yu Yu Hakusho, Cowboy Bebop, Death Note , and Avatar: The Last Airbender are only a few examples of how the platform has capitalized on this new line of…
author: ComicBook

title: Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact Game Adds DLC Character Zeno on June 18
content: Arc System Works streamed a new character video on Thursday for Bushiroad and Eighting's Hunter x Hunter Nen x Impact 2D 3v3 fighting game based on Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter x Hunter manga, and it announces that the DLC character Zeno will launch on June 18 as the fourth and final character of Season Pass 1.
author: ANN

title: Cartoon Network Revival Turns to Horror For Latest Brutal Release
content: Cartoon Network revivals are big business for the cable network these days, with the likes of Regular Show, Adventure Time , and Gumball all receiving stellar comebacks in recent years.
author: ComicBook

title: Omoi to Publish A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort Fantasy Manga Series
content: Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Thursday that it will publish artist Tawa Akeno , author Tsukasa Mikuni , and character designer Sochu's A Snow Fox at the Northern Fort ( Kita no Toride nite ) manga on June 25. Omoi will release new chapters in English weekly.
author: ANN

title: Sentai Filmworks Screens 4K Restoration of Ninja Scroll Anime Film in October in U.S., Canada
content: Sentai Filmworks announced on Thursday that it will screen the 4K version of Ninja Scroll ( Jūbei Ninpūchō ) anime film on October 4, 5, and 7 in the U.S. and Canada. The company streamed a trailer: The company will release the film on a limited edition Blu-ray Disc Steelbook in 4K UHD in early 2027.
author: ANN

title: Mr. Osomatsu Season 4 Anime Streams Unaired 13th Episode
content: The official X/Twitter account for the Mr. Osomatsu anime announced on Friday that the previously unaired 13th episode of the show's fourth season "The Matsuno Ten" has begun streaming in Japan and will air on television on June 13 at 9:30 a.m. on various TV Tokyo networks.
author: ANN

title: The Beloved Imperial Bride Manga Ends With 10th Volume
content: The ninth volume of Mato Kauta 's The Beloved Imperial Bride ( Teikoku no Koiyome ) manga announced on Sunday the series will end with the 10th volume in early spring 2027. The ninth volume will ship on July 3, but is available early now on the Comic CMOA platform.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo' Gets TV Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Coco Uzuki 's Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ( Fall in Love, You False Angels ) manga on Thursday, revealing a commemorative illustration (pictured) by Uzuki. The anime will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Berserk Writer Shares New Preview For Series Return: “A Chapter Miura Agonized Over”
content: It’s been almost a year since we last saw a new story focusing on the likes of Guts, Griffith, and Casca, as Berserk will routinely take some time in releasing its manga chapters.
author: ComicBook

title: Fall in Love, You False Angels Manga Gets TV Anime
content: A new official X/Twitter account opened on Friday to announce that Coco Uzuki 's Fall in Love, You False Angels ( Koiseyo Mayakashi Tenshi-domo ) manga is getting a television anime in 2027.
author: ANN
